verdict.rationale: Checkout.com explicitly markets a Hosted Payment Page you can get 'fully branded... in less than a day' and offers self-serve test accounts, payment links, and low-code Flow for fast integration, suggesting a founder could technically wire up a checkout quickly. However, the pricing model is explicitly sales-led with 'no self-serve rate card' and merchants must 'get in touch with our team' to create a plan, implying an onboarding/underwriting step before going live with real payments that isn't addressed in the evidence. Missing for 10: evidence of self-serve signup-to-live-payment flow without sales contact, KYC/merchant approval timelines, and confirmation that a brand-new account can process a live card charge within 24 hours.
